The person asks:
From which day can I start re-enrolling at the university for the 2027 summer term?

response.text:
Ordnung's records don't store a start date for the re-registration window itself — only the payment deadline for the semester fee. The letter does mention a start date for the Rückmeldezeitraum, but that value is only in the letter text, not in Ordnung's record, so I can't confirm it here; please check it on the letter itself [doc:doc_nba3k0ka85q0].

What's in Ordnung's record for your re-registration (Rückmeldung) for summer semester 2027:

- You re-register simply by transferring the semester fee, due by Fri 15 Jan 2027 (send by Thu 14 Jan 2027) [item:itm_85xesrap412m].
- There's also a related deadline on Sun 28 Feb 2027 (send by Mon 22 Feb 2027) about cancelling a separate Deutschlandticket subscription, since the semester ticket will be included from summer 2027 [item:itm_kn5zf3bdwew8].

So from your records, the concrete action/date you can rely on is the fee due date (15 Jan 2027). For the exact day the re-registration window opens, check the letter from Hochschule Musterstadt [doc:doc_nba3k0ka85q0] directly.
